signature_rules.name: SYN Flood / DoS Rule
signature_rules.description: Triggers when TCP packet rate to port 80 exceeds 500 packets/second from a single source.

signature_rules.name: Port Scan Rule
signature_rules.description: Triggers when a single source IP contacts more than 100 unique destination ports within 10 seconds.

signature_rules.name: SSH Brute Force Rule
signature_rules.description: Triggers when repeated connection/login attempts exceed 10 failures within 60 seconds.

signature_rules.name: Web Attack - SQL Injection
signature_rules.description: Triggers on detection of SQL injection payload signatures (UNION SELECT, OR 1=1) in web requests.

signature_rules.description: Triggers when incoming DNS flood or UDP reflection volume exceeds 1000 packets/second.
